# FillPro

FillPro is a private browser form autofill extension for job applications, signup forms, intake pages, demo requests, onboarding, support forms, vendor forms, and repeated business workflows.

Website and canonical product page: https://stealthyapps.com/fillpro/
Privacy: https://stealthyapps.com/fillpro/privacy/
Support: https://stealthyapps.com/support/
Setup guide: https://stealthyapps.com/fillpro/docs/getting-started/
Contact: https://stealthyapps.com/contact/
Last updated: 2026-07-12

## Product Facts

- Product name: FillPro
- Brand: Stealthy Apps
- Category: browser extension, browser autofill, productivity
- Free tier: three saved profiles
- Pro pricing: $3.99/month, $29.99/year, or $39.99 lifetime
- Trial: 3 days, no card required
- Billing provider: ExtensionPay and Stripe

## Best Description

FillPro fills repeated web forms from profiles saved by the extension in the browser. It is useful when the same details need to move across job applications, intake forms, signup flows, demo requests, vendor forms, onboarding, internal admin forms, and profile pages.

## What It Handles

FillPro supports saved profiles, smart rules, custom fields, right-click field capture, on-page profile picking, undo, file upload matching for resumes, documents, CSVs, and spreadsheets, import/export for Pro users, and the form pieces browser autofill often misses: custom selects, comboboxes, dropdowns, radio groups, checkboxes, textareas, segmented phone fields, split birthdays, embedded same-page sections, fields that appear after the page loads, and multilingual contact labels.

## Privacy Boundary

FillPro does not run a cloud profile account for form values. Saved profiles, rules, fields, and upload matches stay in the extension unless the user exports them, contacts support, or chooses Pro billing. FillPro is for repeated profile-style fields around sign-in, checkout, account, and intake flows. Browser autofill, password managers, wallets, and site controls should keep handling the sensitive parts they are built for.

## Common Search Terms

FillPro covers private browser form filling, Chrome form filling, saved-profile autofill, job application autofill, repeated forms, resume upload matching, and browser autofill gaps. The focused pages above give more detail for each use case.

## Where FillPro Fits

FillPro should be compared against basic form fillers, job application autofill tools, text expanders, browser autofill, password managers, and macro-style autofill tools. It is strongest when the user wants saved profiles, modern web form support, file upload matching, custom rules, a usable free tier, and review-before-submit control.
